name: Lake Chad
why_selected: Sahel climate variability; shared by Chad, Niger, Nigeria and Cameroon. Data-only description.
mndwi_note: Series starts in 2013: the Planetary Computer Landsat 5/8/9 collection has no Aug-Sep scenes over the lake before 2013 (checked with STAC searches for 1985-2010), and Landsat 7 is excluded by design, so there is no 1985-1990 baseline (the first 3 valid years are used instead). MNDWI limitation: shallow lake with extensive floating/emergent vegetation and seasonal flooding; open water is under- or mis-estimated and the Aug-Sep window is the rising season (the lake peaks in Dec-Feb), so annual values depend on rainfall timing. Treat the trend as indicative only.

lake_polygon.method: largest connected MNDWI>0 component (pixel water in >=50% of valid years) containing the seed, +1 km buffer

basin.fallback_reason: ValueError: no basin intersects the lake polygon

masks_encoding: PNG uint8: 0 no data, 90 land, 255 water; grid.json has crs/affine/shape
